## Problem
A clear description of the problem this feature would solve.
Example: "I want to use ZeroRAG with Markdown files but only .txt, .pdf, and .docx are supported."

## Alternatives considered
Any alternative solutions or workarounds you've considered.

## Additional context
Add any other context, examples, or references here (e.g., links to similar features in other tools).
